Local circular moment

Source: R/directional-indicators.R
local_circ_moment.Rd

Computes a kernel-weighted local circular moment of phi conditional on theta.

Usage

local_circ_moment(theta, phi, grid = NULL, kappa = 20)

Arguments

theta

Conditioning angles in radians.

phi

Target angles in radians.

grid

Optional angular grid. If NULL, a default grid is used.

kappa

Circular concentration for local weighting.

Value

A data frame with local real and imaginary components, mean direction mu, and local concentration rho.

See also

Other directional dependence indicators: alignment_index(), conditional_variation_index()

Examples

dat <- simulate_toroidal(n = 80, scenario = "diagonal", seed = 1)
local_circ_moment(dat$theta, dat$phi, grid = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 12))
